PetFaq2.subtitle: FAQS
PetFaq2.description: Find answers to common questions about our pet care services, process, and what to expect.

items.question: What are my options?
items.answer: We offer grooming, bathing, nail trimming, coat care, and wellness services for pets.

items.question: Can I switch to a different plan?
items.answer: Yes. Your planning package can be adjusted as your celebration evolves, subject to availability and the services already confirmed.

items.question: Do you offer non-disclosure signature?
items.answer: Yes. Our team can note your pet?s individual needs and care preferences before an appointment.

items.question: Do you issue refunds?
items.answer: Refund eligibility depends on the selected package, cancellation date and vendor commitments. All terms are clearly explained before confirmation.

items.question: How far in advance should we book your services?
items.answer: We recommend booking appointments in advance, especially during weekends and holiday periods.

items.question: Do you help with travel and accommodation for guests?
items.answer: Yes. Our pet care support can include travel guidance, accommodation coordination, transfers and guest hospitality.

items.question: Do you offer care for pets of different sizes?
items.answer: Yes. We plan intimate ceremonies as well as large multi-day celebrations, tailoring the team and planning process to suit your guest count.

items.question: Do you provide customised pet care themes and dÃ©cor?
items.answer: Yes. Our designers create personalised themes, floral concepts, colour palettes and decor details around your preferred style.

items.question: Will you coordinate with local vendors at the destination?
items.answer: Yes. We source, brief and coordinate trusted local vendors while maintaining one clear plan and timeline for the entire celebration.

items.question: How do we get started with PETLIO?
items.answer: Book an initial consultation and share your date, location, guest count and vision. Our team will then recommend the most suitable planning approach.

services.title: Pet Grooming
services.imageAlt: A small dog enjoying a fresh bath and blow dry
services.subtitle: PROFESSIONAL PET GROOMING
services.heading: Gentle Grooming for a Healthier, Happier Pet
services.description: Our pet grooming services keep your furry friend clean, healthy, comfortable and looking their best. We use pet-friendly products and gentle techniques for a calm, stress-free visit. From bathing and brushing to haircuts and nail trimming, our groomers provide complete care with love and attention.
services.offerDescription: Every grooming visit is tailored to your pet?s coat, comfort and individual needs.
services.closingDescription: Regular grooming helps maintain a clean coat, supports healthy skin, reduces shedding and keeps your pet comfortable in every season.

services.title: Veterinary Care
services.imageAlt: Veterinarians providing a gentle examination to a cat
services.subtitle: COMPASSIONATE VETERINARY CARE
services.heading: Trusted Veterinary Care for Every Stage of Life
services.description: Our veterinary team brings thoughtful, thorough care to every visit. From preventive checkups to guidance when your pet is unwell, we focus on clear communication, gentle handling and care tailored to your companion.
services.offerDescription: We help you understand your pet?s health and make confident choices at every step.
services.closingDescription: From routine checkups to clear guidance at home, our team helps you make confident choices for your companion?s health.

services.title: Dog Training
services.imageAlt: A person providing calm, hands-on care to a golden retriever
services.subtitle: POSITIVE DOG TRAINING
services.heading: Build Good Habits and a Stronger Bond
services.description: Our positive, reward-based training helps dogs learn useful skills while building trust with their people. We adapt every session to your dog?s age, personality and goals, creating steady progress in a supportive setting.
services.offerDescription: Practical training gives you and your dog the confidence to enjoy more of life together.
services.closingDescription: Positive, consistent training helps your dog build good habits and enjoy a closer, happier relationship with you.

services.title: Pet Sitting
services.imageAlt: A caregiver bathing a dog in an outdoor tub
services.subtitle: LOVING PET SITTING
services.heading: Familiar, Reassuring Care While You?re Away
services.description: Your pet can stay comfortable in familiar surroundings while a trusted sitter keeps up with their everyday routine. We provide attentive visits, companionship and updates, always following the care instructions you share.
services.offerDescription: We follow your pet?s routine and care preferences to help them feel safe, settled and loved.
services.closingDescription: A familiar routine, kind attention and regular updates help your pet stay relaxed and cared for at home.

PetMissionVision2.title: Our
PetMissionVision2.description: We are committed to providing the best care, comfort and happiness for every pet, while building a healthier and kinder world for animals.
PetMissionVision2.missionDescription: Our mission is to provide high-quality, compassionate and personalized pet care services that improve the health, happiness and well-being of every pet. We strive to create a safe, comfortable and loving environment where pets receive the best grooming, nutrition and care.
PetMissionVision2.visionDescription: Our vision is to be the most trusted and preferred pet care brand, known for exceptional service, innovation and a deeper commitment to animal well-being. We aim to build a happier, healthier and more pet-friendly community for generations to come.
PetMissionVision2.imageAlt: A happy golden retriever and cat surrounded by soft paw-print details
